title: High-genus Bertini-link free-product quotients for complex cubic del Pezzo fibrations over curves
author: Jérémy Blanc; Egor Yasinsky
work: Quotients of groups of birational transformations of cubic del Pezzo fibrations
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 7 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.136
difficulty_reason: The cited Sarkisov presentation and boundedness theorem alone do not make the proposed link assignment kill every elementary relation. The author first obtains a uniform genus bound for relations over a point, then tracks the competing divisorial contractions over a curve to prove that a remaining high-genus relation has four links with two equivalent Bertini links. That new geometric relation analysis is the obligation that makes the free-product groupoid homomorphism well defined.
